description: Scenario A. Idle 2560x1440@144 desktop as the capture source. Measures what the frontend, the preview path and the process cost when the source barely changes, so any delta is application overhead rather than workload interference.
source_notes: Idle Windows desktop on the primary LG 27GL850 (2560x1440@144, SDR, 10-bit RGB). No game, no frame generation.
settings_rationale: The shipped default profile for screen capture: MKV + AV1 + Opus, CFR 60 fps, 4:2:0, 8-bit, SDR, SYS on / MIC off. Chosen over a stripped-down configuration because the campaign is supposed to measure normal production-like recording; a silent audio path would leave the audio thread, the mux and the clock slaving out of the comparison. Identical on both frontends either way, so it biases nothing.
